title: Tobermory Cruise Line
specs: See Big Tub Lighthouse, Cove Island Lighthouse, Flowerpot Island, the Grotto on jet ski tours
Kayak rentals launch from docks with views of Tobermory harbour and nearby shipwrecks
Must be 21+ years of age to drive jet skis
Valid driver's licence required to drive jet skis; boat licence accepted but driver's licence still required
Jet ski tours can include driver only or driver plus passenger; additional drivers available
includes: Wetsuits and life jackets provided at no extra charge for jet ski tours
Paddles, lifejackets, and safety kits included with kayak and SUP rentals
gap: Duration of jet ski tours not stated
blurb: Guests can take guided jet ski tours to see landmarks like Flowerpot Island and the Grotto or rent kayaks and stand up paddleboards to explore local shipwrecks. Jet ski tours require prepayment and a damage deposit, with provided wetsuits and life jackets. Kayak and SUP rentals are available on a first come, first served basis from May to September, with coaching for beginners.
extraNote: More Information Be sure to arrive prepared for changing weather. · Weather on the lake is often cooler and breezier than on shore. · Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 72 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · Late arrivals and no-shows will forfeit their booking payment and are not entitled to a refund. · the company reserves the right, without liability, to cancel, delay, shorten or change tour schedules and routes when in its judgement, circumstances warrant. · Tobermory Cruise Line has a no refund, no cancellation policy.

All tours are weather dependent.
